description: This file defines the class 'ThingCommandSizeValidator', which is a singleton validator for checking the size of 'thing' commands in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends 'AbstractCommandSizeValidator' and creates 'ThingTooLargeException' instances when size constraints are violated.

classes.name: ThingCommandSizeValidator
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for validating the size of 'thing' commands, throwing 'ThingTooLargeException' if the size exceeds the configured maximum.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides the singleton instance of 'ThingCommandSizeValidator', initializing it with the maximum size limit from system properties if not already created.

methods.name: newInvalidSizeException
methods.description: Creates a new 'ThingTooLargeException' indicating that the size of the command exceeds the maximum allowed, including relevant headers.
